releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 修复真机更新检查偶发异常，新增更新下载超时保护；移除触发 Flutter 未来版本兼容性警告的插件依赖；优化总览页小屏显示。
releaseNotes.zh-Hant: 修復真機更新檢查偶發異常，新增更新下載逾時保護；移除觸發 Flutter 未來版本相容性警告的外掛依賴；優化總覽頁小螢幕顯示。
releaseNotes.en: Fix intermittent real-device update check failures, add download timeout protection, remove plugin dependencies that triggered future Flutter compatibility warnings, and improve overview layout on small screens.

message.zh-Hans: iOS 版本将在 TestFlight 或 App Store 接入后开放。

message.en: iOS releases will be available after TestFlight or App Store integration.
